main_text.p: תודה f. Confesio, Laus: plur. תודות .

יהוּדָה Jehuda. Chald. יהוד Dan.2.25. יְהוּדִי Judaeus, plur. יהודים Judaei. Chald. יְהוּדָאִין & יְהוּדָיָא, Dan. 3. יהודית Judaea: Judaicè. Hinc Part. factū ex forma Hithp. מִתְיַהֲדִים Judaizantes, fiebant Judaei, Esth.8.17.

יָדַע Scire, Nosse, Cognoscere, Experiri. Niphal נוֹדַע Notum fieri, Cognosci. Pihel יְדַע Notum facere. Ex Pyhal מְיֻדָּע Notus, Familiaris. Hiphil הוֹדִיעַ Notum, vel Scire facere, Indicare. Hophal הוּדַע Notum fieri. Hithpahel, הִתְוַדַּע Cognoscendum prabere se. Chald. יְדַע Idem. יָדַעְתָּ Cognovisti: יָדַעַת Cognovi: יָדַע Sciens: יָדְעִין Scientes: יָדְעָא Notum: דַּע Scito: אִנְדַּע Sciam: יִגְּדְעוּן Cognoscent. Aphel הוֹדַע Notum fecit: הוֹדַעְתַּנִי Notum fecisti mihi: הוֹדַעְנוּ Notum fecimus: מְהוֹדְעִין Notum facientes: לְהוֹדְעָרָה Ad notum faciendum: לְהוֹדִעוּתְךָ Ad notum faciendum tibi: יְהוֹדִיעַ Notum faciet, &c.
דַּע m. Scientia, Sententia: plur. דְּעִים Fam. דֵּעָה plur. דֵּעוֹת. דַּעַת Idem.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are copied from the scan at low resolution; the vowel points and several Hebrew words in the entries (especially in the Aphel and Hithpahel forms, and the final entry) are uncertain and may contain errors. Not checked against the printed source.
